purpose: Bring up a familiar target for an exasperated comment.
keywords: That dog of ours has hidden my shoes again.
This device keeps switching itself off.
My little brother forgot every single thing I asked for.
restrictions: Usually introduces a complaint or an emotional assessment.
mistake: It can sound rude when used directly about another person.
